text:
Legacy Gemini CLI OAuth is **deprecated** and no longer supported in Hermes Agent.

### Solution
Switch to using a **Google AI Studio API key**:
1. Get an API key from [Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com/).
2. Set it as an environment variable:
   ```bash
   GEMINI_API_KEY="your-api-key"
   ```
   *(or use `GOOGLE_API_KEY="your-api-key"`)*
3. Run `hermes setup` (or update your config) to use standard Gemini API key authentication.
